function.name: music_generate
function.description: Generate a piece of music given a key, tempo, and time signature.

key.description: The key of the piece, e.g., C Major.

tempo.description: Tempo of the piece in beats per minute.

time_signature.description: Time signature of the piece, e.g., 4/4. Default '4/4'

function.name: audio_generate
function.description: Generate an audio signal given a frequency, amplitude, and duration.

frequency.description: Frequency of the audio signal in Hz. This is a float type value.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the audio signal. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of the audio signal in seconds. Default 1
